$doc: M1 confirmation as a 2x2 FACTORIAL (Musashi correction to the original §10 design): M0 lacked a normal-only reduced-LR arm, so easy's causal contribution is unproven — the benefit could be entirely the LR. This factorial measures the easy main effect, the LR main effect and their interaction under equal compute. launch_eligible stays false until Musashi's M0 audit selects the winner multiplier.

interpretation.easy_contributes: E4_N10 at winner mult survives where N14 at winner mult fails (or is materially worse) in >=3/4 seeds
interpretation.lr_only: N14 at winner mult survives comparably to E4_N10 at winner mult: attribute nothing to easy
interpretation.interaction: compare all four cells; a full-LR cell surviving would contradict M0 and demands investigation
interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: mixed cells meeting no rule, any unverifiable record, or anchor-fallback contamination: no gene freezing, escalate to Musashi

forbidden: changing any factor beyond schedule and normal LR multiplier
